segments.an3.147:1.1: “Tīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
segments.an3.147:1.3: Sāvajjena kāyakammena, sāvajjena vacīkammena, sāvajjena manokammena – imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
segments.an3.147:2.1: “Tīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge.
segments.an3.147:2.3: Anavajjena kāyakammena, anavajjena vacīkammena, anavajjena manokammena – imehi kho … pe … evaṃ sagge”ti.
